title: BlackboardConvergenceReport.v1
description: The convergence accounting for one blackboard: how many iterations the swarm ran and how many gaps were open vs closed at the stopping point. converged is true when the swarm reached its stopping condition (typically open_gaps == 0); reason records why it stopped (converged | budget_exhausted | max_iterations | blocked). Convergence is an operational/benchmark verdict over working state — it is NOT a promotion authority; benchmark != promotion. Reaching convergence never makes the synthesis served truth.

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this report accounts for

iterations.description: number of iterations/rounds the swarm ran

open_gaps.description: gaps still open at the stopping point

converged.description: true if the swarm reached its stopping condition (typically open_gaps == 0)

reason.description: why the run stopped; an operational/benchmark verdict, never a promotion authority
